svg.title: Ягодичный мост с двумя гирями — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Floor glute bridge holding TWO kettlebells securely on front of pelvis, three-quarter side view from low enough to see hips and both distinct kettlebell loops. Shoulders and head on same floor, both feet flat knees bent in both phases. One clearly shaped kettlebell resting on each side of front pelvis with hands stabilizing their separate loop handles. START buttocks down at floor, weights on pelvis. FINISH lift pelvis until shoulder–hip–knee line straight, both kettlebells travel with hips; both shoulders and feet stay on floor. No bench, no dumbbells, no barbell. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
